##### Project general facts

Baystar by Vida is an elegant waterfront development that brings together the sophistication of Vida Hotels & Resorts with the dynamic spirit of Rashid Yachts & Marina. Featuring a sleek modern façade, the building rises gracefully along the shoreline, offering a lifestyle that seamlessly blends luxury with coastal serenity. Its design reflects a refined minimalism, enriched with soft curves and panoramic glass, capturing the rhythm of the sea and sky.

Inside, each residence is thoughtfully crafted to reflect understated elegance and modern comfort. The apartments are designed with open layouts that invite natural light, offering tranquil views of the water and skyline. Refined finishes, carefully selected textures, and a neutral palette create a warm, inviting atmosphere where every detail contributes to a sense of calm sophistication.

Baystar by Vida offers residents a curated lifestyle enriched with exceptional amenities. From a stunning infinity pool and fitness center to serene landscaped gardens and social lounges, every space has been created to promote well-being and leisure. With direct beach access and the signature hospitality of Vida, this is coastal living elevated to new heights.

##### Finishing and materials

Modern finishing using high quality materials.

##### Kitchen and appliances

Equipped kitchens.

##### Furnishing

No.

##### Location description and benefits

Rashid Yachts & Marina is the new global destination for discerning yacht owners to experience Dubai’s buzzing scene in an elegant environment where beauty and luxury collide. Designed to encapsulate the ultimate modern waterfront architecture, it combines luxury residences and a full-service marina with an appealing mix of restaurants and shops.

The new Marina at Rashid Yachts & Marina offers convenient, hassle-free access to Dubai, accommodating 430 wet berths for yachts up to 100m long with a range of flexible berthing options, from a single night through to seasonal and annual stays. You will benefit from the Marina’s state-of-the-art facilities, an expert, multilingual marina team offering yacht assistance around the clock, and a host of amenities and services you will find at your disposal.

A luxurious residential haven with modern amenities, beautiful scenery, and access to exciting local hotspots, Rashid Yachts & Marina is the perfect place to relax and explore in proximity to some of Dubai’s most exciting attractions.
